scams.name: 'Relative in Your Country' Opener
scams.setup: A stranger claims a personal connection to the tourist's home country to build instant rapport.
scams.mechanism: Lowers social guard, leads into an invitation to a relative's shop.
scams.countermeasure: Friendly small talk from strangers who quickly pivot to 'come see my shop' is a strong scam signal, regardless of the story.
